rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for joining noun phrases or clauses.

example.english: I bought bread and milk today.
example.traditional: 我今日買咗麵包同埋牛奶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 min6 baau1 tung4 maai4 ngau4 naai5

rows.note: Use 同 mainly to coordinate people or other noun phrases in short everyday combinations.

example.english: You and I are going together.
example.jyutping: nei5 tung4 ngo5 jat1 cai4 heoi3

rows.note: Use 跟住 when the second clause follows the first in time or as its ensuing result.

example.english: We finished eating, and then went to see a movie.
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 gan1 zyu6 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use 又 when reading a mixed fraction such as 一又二分之一.

example.english: This rope is one and a half metres long.
example.traditional: 呢條繩係一又二分之一米長。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 hai6 jat1 jau6 ji6 fan1 zi1 jat1 mai5 coeng4
